Revise a Clonotrace clone distance

Source: R/revised_distance.R
revise_clone_distance.Rd

Locally rescales a Clonotrace clone-distance matrix and optionally blends it with Euclidean distance between clone centroids in the supplied cell embedding. The centroid weight can be fixed by the user or selected without fate/cell-type labels by agreement with multiresolution RNA-cluster composition differences.

Usage

revise_clone_distance(
  clone_dis,
  embedding,
  clone_labels = NULL,
  cell_clone_prob = NULL,
  clone_names = NULL,
  sample = NULL,
  local_k = 7L,
  local_rescale = FALSE,
  resolutions = c(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1.2),
  clusters = NULL,
  cluster_k = 15L,
  mean_weight = NULL,
  s_grid = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
  seed = 0L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

clone_dis

Clone distances as either a named square matrix or a long table with columns group1, group2, and dis. Long-form clone identifiers may be names or one-based positions in clone_names.

embedding

Finite numeric cells-by-dimensions embedding with unique cell names as row names.

clone_labels

Observed clone membership as a data frame with columns cell and clone, or as a vector named by cell. This is preferred for centroid calculation when exact observed membership is available.

cell_clone_prob

Optional non-negative cells-by-clones membership or probability matrix. Used only when clone_labels is NULL.

clone_names

Clone identifiers in distance-matrix order. Inferred from named square distances or cell_clone_prob when possible.

sample

Optional clone-level grouping, such as patient. Supply a vector named by clone or in clone_names order. If given, normalization and automatic weight selection use only within-group clone pairs.

local_k

Positive integer nearest-neighbor rank used when local_rescale = TRUE.

local_rescale

Logical. Apply clone-specific local distance rescaling. Defaults to FALSE; the input Clonotrace geometry is otherwise retained up to a single global median normalization.

resolutions

Positive Leiden resolutions used to choose the automatic centroid weight.

clusters

Optional precomputed cell-cluster data frame or matrix with cell row names and one column per resolution. This replaces internal Leiden clustering.

cluster_k

Positive integer number of neighbors in the cell graph used by the internal Leiden ladder.

mean_weight

Optional fixed centroid weight in [0, 1]. If supplied, automatic selection is skipped.

s_grid

Candidate centroid weights in [0, 1].

seed

Integer random seed for the Leiden ladder.

verbose

Logical; report the selected centroid weight.

Value

A symmetric named clone-distance matrix. Attributes include

mean_weight, per-resolution picks, the original

clonotrace distance, and clone-specific local_scale.

Details

The revision has three steps:

  1. Optional local rescaling: when local_rescale = TRUE, use \(D_{ij}/\sqrt{\sigma_i\sigma_j}\), where \(\sigma_i\) is the distance to clone i's local_k-th nearest clone. This is disabled by default because it changes clone-neighbour rankings rather than merely changing distance units.

  2. Clone-centroid distance: Euclidean distance between observed clone means in the cell embedding. If clone_labels is unavailable, cell_clone_prob supplies probability weights.

  3. Median normalization and blending: \((1-s)D_{local} + sD_{centroid}\). When mean_weight is NULL, s is selected at each cell-clustering resolution by maximizing Spearman agreement with clone cluster-composition total variation, and the median selected value is used.

The automatic procedure is fate-blind but RNA-cluster-informed. For method comparisons, retain the unrevised distance as an ablation and avoid treating the selected weight as independent of transcriptomic cluster structure.
